name: sistema-de-checkin
description: Check-in hospitalar com NestJS, React, totem e fila em memória

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend -- --runInBand && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend -- --runInBand
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
